name: Languedoc-Roussillon
terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.
France's simplest category, in use since 2010. It replaced vin de table.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.
keyfacts: In the Banyuls Grand Cru AOC, the wine must be aged in wooden vessels until 1 June of the third year after the harvest.
Crémant de Limoux uses the traditional method.

notes: Syrah here goes into Rhône-style blends with Grenache, blends with Cabernet Sauvignon, and single-variety wines.
The vins doux naturels are sweet wines fortified during fermentation to keep their sugar.

blurb.text: A large wine region on the Mediterranean coast of southern France. It includes Pic Saint-Loup, Faugères, Minervois, Corbières, Fitou and Limoux.
